intro: Between 12 April and 27 August 2026, ZCyberNews catalogued 89 supply-chain articles. Coverage spans 52 high-severity, 16 critical, 16 medium, and 4 informational reports. Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and CanisterSprawl were each observed in distinct campaigns. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-45033, CVE-2026-39987, CVE-2026-41650, and CVE-2026-44664. Affected sectors range from technology and software development to cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing. Reports track activity across Global, North America, Europe, Asia, and the United States.
